name: pr8-build
argv:
set -e; source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; source /driver_work/install/setup.bash; if test -f /pr8-install/setup.bash; then source /pr8-install/setup.bash; fi; unset ROS_STATIC_PEERS ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE FASTDDS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE CYCLONEDDS_URI; export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=181 RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_fastrtps_cpp ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE=LOCALHOST PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ROS_LOG_DIR=/pr8-review/roslogs XML_CATALOG_FILES=/acceptance-tools/offline-schema/catalog.xml GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=/pr8-source; cd /pr8-source; git rev-parse HEAD
git status --porcelain
export CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=2 MAKEFLAGS='-j2 -l2'
colcon --log-base /pr8-review/build-log build --build-base /pr8-build --install-base /pr8-install --packages-up-to mtc_cpp_mock_bringup --executor sequential --cmake-args -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=17 -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON
